Add-ons

Who installs, who uses

Admin installsfrom the library or a file
Admin turns it onand approves the service
Users use itwith the add-ons feature, in the Tools menu of a chat
Each person connectstheir own account, such as a mailbox

What an add-on can add to LocalAI

Toolsfor chats and agents
Skillsinstructions for agents
Pagesin the web UI
Servicessuch as a chat app
An installed add-on is trusted codeIt runs as the system user that runs LocalAI. The install dialog shows what it may do.
An admin decides what is installed. Each user decides what to use.
